name: Tama Tama Christmas Box
source:
It's been a year since the fateful encounter with the voice actress and love egg. This time new voice actress comes to the town to realize her dream. When main character shakes hands with her, a nostalgic feeling arises in him. He feels affinity for this girl. Where will this encounter bring him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
距离与声优和恋爱之蛋的命运相遇已经过去了一年。这次，一位新的声优来到小镇实现她的梦想。当主人公与她握手时，心中涌起一股怀念的感觉。他对这个女孩感到亲切。这次相遇将把他带向何方？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
